owner: existing static i18n cache patch directory and brain-static-i18n cache tests
root_cause: The BRAIN backend lane failed with STATIC_I18N_CACHE_INCOMPLETE: 5 missing translation(s) on five consecutive main merges. A patch for the blog existed but keyed the text as separate sentences, while the build looks up the final page blocks, so five exact keys never matched.
prevention_rule: The five exact build keys are added to a second patch using the existing sentence translations, and the lesson plus rule make agents check the patch against STATIC_I18N_CACHE_MISSING after any public text change. No test is weakened and the cache check stays fail-closed.

historical: BRAIN delivery post-merge runs red on main for #5488, #5486, #5489, #5491 and #5490 with the same STATIC_I18N_CACHE_INCOMPLETE error

Failing tests that name the gap: tests/brain-static-i18n-production-cache-completeness-v1.test.mjs and tests/brain-static-i18n-versioned-cache-v1.test.mjs run in the backend lane, which installs dependencies; the admission evaluation does not, so they are evidence here, not evaluation tests
current: Key comparison: all five missing build keys are absent from the existing patch and present in the new one; lessons and rules parity checked locally
